a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: A reply that takes the point that was made and answers it with a reason.
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: A reply that takes the point that was made and answers it with a reason.

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: 相手が述べた論点を捉え、その理由に返して反論すること。単に拒むだけのことや、話 unrelated な話題へ移すことは含まれない。
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: 相手の論点に直接Reasonsして反論すること。

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: 상대가 한 말을 그대로 받아들인 뒤 근거와 추론으로 답하는 말이다. 단순히 주장을 부인하거나 상대를 비난하는 것과는 다르다.
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: 상대의 주장에 대해 이유를 들어 답하는 반론이다.

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: Réplica que compreende o ponto levantado e lhe responde com argumentos ou razões, em vez de ignorá-lo ou desviar do assunto.
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: Resposta que retoma um argumento e apresenta uma razão contra ele.

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: คำตอบที่รับประเด็นที่อีกฝ่ายยกขึ้นแล้วตอบด้วยเหตุผล มิใช่เพียงเปลี่ยนหรือหลบประเด็น
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: ข้อโต้แย้งที่ตอบประเด็นด้วยเหตุผล

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: Karşı argüman, savunulan noktayı doğrudan ele alıp ona karşı bir gerekçe sunar. Yalnızca konuyu değiştirerek verilen bir yanıt, karşı argüman sayılmaz.
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: Bir savunmanın dayandığı noktayı gerekçeyle yanıtlama.

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.definition: Tanggapan yang mengambil argimen yang telah dibuat lalu menjawabnya dengan alasan atau dasar yang relevan.
a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.gloss: Tanggapan yang menjawab suatu argumen dengan alasan.

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.translation: Sanggahannya memberikan alasan dan meminta pengujian yang sama juga dilakukan terhadap pihak lain.
Karşı argümanında, öne sürülen savın neden yetersiz olduğunu açıklayan bir gerekçe sundu.
ข้อโต้แย้งอธิบายเหตุผลและขอให้ใช้การทดสอบแบบเดียวกันกับอีกฝ่ายหนึ่ง
A réplica apresentou uma razão e solicitou a mesma verificação para o outro lado.
그 반박은 이유를 제시하고 상대방에게도 같은 기준으로 검토해 보라고 요구했다.
その反論は相手の論点を捉え、根拠を示して同じ基準で検討を求めました。

a0cecbead27dfb0d580737b7a77b2a0864ab7695.text: The rebuttal gave the reason and asked for the same test on the other side.
